reason: Stream R (F11), rebased onto Stream A (#605). Replaces Stream A's single excerpt-selection point (_retrieved_excerpts, whole messages by raw term counts) with the chunked ranker in the new pure module context_retrieval.py (paragraph-aligned passages, BM25 with rarity-weighted identifier boost, tail-aware query fed from the kept tail, optional dense RRF via the knowledge index's local model when already ready); fitted() inside _model_context becomes async so ranking runs in a worker thread; A's placement (after the current message) and heading are kept, payload entries gain an optional part. Adds the conversation.search Core tool (conversation_search.py; LOCAL_READ analysis tool covering exactly the latest ready snapshot's source messages in the active projection), offered only on tool turns whose request is compacted, recorded in the request snapshot and rebuilt on resume, with its definition reserved (archive_reserved_tokens) only on the compaction path; conversation.search joins RETRIEVAL_TOOL_NAMES; ChromaKnowledgeIndex.embed. Selected: the two new test files; Stream A's full selection (every file driving _model_context, compacted prepare, tool loops, goals, subagents, agent messages, turn accounting and the runtime-switch preflight node), since the assembly function and turn reserve changed, minus test_orchestration.py; plus restart recovery of rerunnable reads, the knowledge index (new embed), structured results and tool catalog (exact tool spec sets, resume rebuild), and API stream context. test_chat_context_assembly.py's trigger test now compares routing with the compacted turn's own reserve, which includes the search tool's definition. Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI, Rust or visible layout changes; the tool's activity renders through the existing generic native tool card by its display_name. test_orchestration.py is excluded: mission compaction and dependency retrieval (context.lexical_score) are unchanged and do not use _model_context. Real-Core evidence (scratch Core on 18716, OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, 12K window) is recorded in the PR body. No full suite.
